limitations: This roadmap schedules deterministic implementation work. It does not build, deploy, or execute a candidate.
A wave position is a planning priority, not routing eligibility, qualification, execution authority, or proof of safety.
The roadmap does not choose a provider, model, endpoint, tool, credential, evidence authority, reviewer, or target.
Authoritative candidate qualification remains blocked by architecture decision D008. Component construction and advisory preflight can proceed independently.
Every wave remains subject to domain commander review, independent Control review, and independent Assurance review before any separately authorized state transition.

priority_tiers.meaning: The command has no specialist eligible under the selected routing policy.
The specialist is policy eligible but lacks a nonfixture candidate implementation.
The command has an eligible baseline and this specialist adds implementation depth.
